articles.title: Bitcoin pulls back to $64,000 after hitting monthly high as bears take control
articles.snippet: Profit-taking after bitcoin hit a $65,500 monthly high combined with fresh Iranian strikes on U.S. bases sent crypto lower, with bears leading price action across most tokens.

articles.title: U.S. Senate unanimously opposes clemency for FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried
articles.snippet: The nonbinding resolution passed without objection after Bankman-Fried asked for clemency, months after Trump pardoned other major crypto figures, including Changpeng Zhao and Ross Ulbricht.

articles.title: Ether outruns bitcoin as ETF money returns, almost all of from BlackRock's fund
articles.snippet: This is not a broad rally as bitcoin is up 4% over the same stretch, and solana, TRON and hyperliquid are all lower.

articles.title: Gambling on random Pokémon cards: Onchain gagcha hits record high as crypto sinks
articles.snippet: Users spent a record $324 million on onchain gacha in June, even as Bitcoin hit a 21-month low. The thrill of scoring a top Pokemon card from a random pack is becoming big business

articles.title: Is Robinhood Chain’s success bullish or bearish for ETH the asset?
articles.snippet: Surging volumes on Robinhood Chain could be very good for Ethereum, but only if the “ETH is money” crowd turn out to be right.
